tools.name: delete_reservation
tools.description: Permanently deletes a reservation and its special requests from the reservation book. This cannot be undone.

params.name: reservation_id
params.description: ID of the reservation to delete.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("reservations")
DB_PATH = "/var/lib/reservations/bookings.db"


@mcp.tool()
def delete_reservation(reservation_id: int) -> str:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT guest_name FROM reservations WHERE id = ?", (reservation_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return f"Reservation {reservation_id} not found."
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM special_requests WHERE reservation_id = ?", (reservation_id,))
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM reservations WHERE id = ?", (reservation_id,))
    return f"Deleted reservation {reservation_id} for {row[0]}."

tools.name: purge_expired_waitlist_entries
tools.description: Permanently removes waitlist entries for a restaurant whose requested date has already passed. Returns how many entries were removed.

params.name: restaurant_id
params.description: Identifier of the restaurant whose waitlist should be purged.

params.name: before_date
params.description: Entries with a requested date earlier than this YYYY-MM-DD date are removed.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/reservations/bookings.db"


@tool
def purge_expired_waitlist_entries(restaurant_id: str, before_date: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM waitlist WHERE restaurant_id = ? AND requested_date < ?",
            (restaurant_id, before_date),
        )
        conn.commit()
        removed = cur.rowcount
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result = {"restaurant_id": restaurant_id, "before_date": before_date, "removed": removed}
    return result
